root.command: SELECT c.ContactID, c.CompanyName, c.ContactTypeID, ct.ContactTypeDesc FROM dbo.ContactsTbl c LEFT JOIN dbo.ContactTypesTbl ct ON ct.ContactTypeID = c.ContactTypeID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Zuka%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Marunic%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Float%' OR (c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Cape Coffee%' AND c.CompanyName NOT LIKE N'%Beans%') ORDER BY c.CompanyName;

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ContactTypesTbl WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier') BEGIN INSERT INTO dbo.ContactTypesTbl (ContactTypeDesc) VALUES (N'Supplier'); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'DriverCollectionOnly') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE dbo.ContactTypesTbl ADD DriverCollectionOnly BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_ContactTypesTbl_DriverCollectionOnly DEFAULT (0); END

IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'U') IS NOT NULL AND COL_LENGTH(N'dbo.ContactTypesTbl', N'DriverCollectionOnly') IS NOT NULL BEGIN UPDATE dbo.ContactTypesTbl SET DriverCollectionOnly = 1 WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier'; END

SELECT ct.ContactTypeID, ct.ContactTypeDesc, ISNULL(ct.DriverCollectionOnly, 0) AS DriverCollectionOnly, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.ContactsTbl c WHERE c.ContactTypeID = ct.ContactTypeID) AS ContactCount FROM dbo.ContactTypesTbl ct WHERE LTRIM(RTRIM(ct.ContactTypeDesc)) = N'Supplier' OR ISNULL(ct.DriverCollectionOnly, 0) = 1 ORDER BY ct.ContactTypeDesc;
SELECT c.ContactID, c.CompanyName, ct.ContactTypeDesc FROM dbo.ContactsTbl c LEFT JOIN dbo.ContactTypesTbl ct ON ct.ContactTypeID = c.ContactTypeID WHERE c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Zuka%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Marunic%' OR c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Float%' OR (c.CompanyName LIKE N'%Cape Coffee%' AND c.CompanyName NOT LIKE N'%Beans%') ORDER BY c.CompanyName;
